site.eyebrow: Solar Support · PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
site.title: Solar PV Learning Path
site.lede: Interactive lessons, simulators, sizing trainers and practice quizzes for rooftop solar, arranged in teaching order: from the Sun's movement to sizing a complete plant. Most lessons switch between English, Hindi and Malayalam.
site.author: PRASAD UM, VI

modules.title: The Sun and the sky
modules.note: Why seasons happen, where the Sun is at any hour, and how tilt changes what a panel receives.

items.title: Why we have seasons in India
items.desc: 3D orbit model: 23.5° axial tilt, equinoxes, solstices, perihelion and aphelion, with IMD season colours.

items.title: Seasons, step by step
items.desc: Guided lesson with voice narration that walks through the Earth's orbit one position at a time.

items.title: Sun angles: elevation, azimuth, zenith
items.desc: Move the Sun over a sky dome and read α, θz and γ. Real-sun mode for Kozhikode, Port Blair and other cities.

items.title: Sun path chart – Kozhikode
items.desc: Polar and rectangular sun path charts with sunrise, sunset, day length and noon elevation for the 21st of each month.

items.title: Solar Pathfinder shade survey
items.desc: Why shade matters, parts of the Pathfinder, true north and magnetic declination, placement, the sunpath diagram, a shading simulator, worked examples and a quiz.

items.title: Tilt, irradiance and time of day
items.desc: Three-panel simulation for Port Blair and Kozhikode: sun path by month, recommended tilt, series/parallel, Isc, Voc and daily power curve.

modules.title: Solar cells and PV modules
modules.note: From the silicon atom to the module datasheet, and what shading does to a string.

items.title: Semiconductors, PN junction and solar cell
items.desc: Doping, depletion layer, bias, diode V–I curve, solar cell I–V curve, fill factor, and cell → module → array.

items.title: Solar cell I-V curve lab
items.desc: Plot the I-V curve point by point using load resistors at 200, 600 and 1000 W/m², and compare 25 °C with 45 °C.

items.title: PV module technologies – visual overview
items.desc: Mono, poly, thin film, PERC, TOPCon, HJT, half-cut and bifacial explained with diagrams.

items.title: PV module technologies – detailed reference
items.desc: Manufacturing, comparison of efficiency and degradation, IS/IEC standards, reading a datasheet, worked numericals.

items.title: Hotspots, bypass and blocking diodes
items.desc: Shade one cell and watch heating, I–V and P–V curves; bypass and blocking diode action, testing and faults.

modules.title: Solar systems and components
modules.note: On-grid, off-grid and hybrid systems, the inverter, and everything else between panel and grid.

items.title: Solar energy systems – classroom slides
items.desc: On-grid, off-grid, hybrid, islanding and anti-islanding, BESS and IEC standards, comparison table.

items.title: Solar PV systems and BESS
items.desc: Detailed on-grid, off-grid and hybrid layouts, isolation, protection devices and battery energy storage.

items.title: Solar inverter types
items.desc: Inside an inverter, off-grid, on-grid, hybrid and micro inverters, datasheets, MPPT and the string voltage window.

items.title: Balance of System (BoS)
items.desc: Structures, cables and MC4, DCDB and ACDB, earthing and lightning arrester, metering, BoS sizing and testing.

modules.title: Batteries and charge controllers
modules.note: Storage chemistry, charging, and how fast a battery can safely be discharged.

items.title: Lead-acid batteries and charge controllers
items.desc: Construction, chemistry, C10/C20 ratings, charging stages, common problems, PWM vs MPPT, connections and pricing.

items.title: Lithium solar batteries
items.desc: LiFePO₄ types, construction, live BMS demo, settings, pros and cons, care, safety and installation.

items.title: C-rating of battery
items.desc: What C-rate means, discharge time calculator, battery types, high-C effects, reading labels, worked examples and quiz.

items.title: Battery discharge time calculator
items.desc: Enter Ah or mAh and pick a C-rate from C/20 to 20C to get discharge time, current and typical applications.

modules.title: System sizing
modules.note: Work a full design from the load survey, with every number calculated live.

items.title: Grid-tie rooftop PV sizing
items.desc: Load survey → plant capacity, modules, inverter, string connection, energy exported to the grid and protection.

items.title: Off-grid sizing – quick trainer
items.desc: Six short steps with your own wattages: loads, hours, inverter VA, battery bank, PV array and charge controller.

items.title: Stand-alone PV sizing trainer
items.desc: Load survey, watt-hours, inverter VA, system voltage, battery bank, PV array, standard panels and controller rating.

modules.title: Practice and assessment
modules.note: Self-check quizzes with instant feedback. The Google Form question banks follow below.

items.title: Solar Smart Technician Challenge
items.desc: 30 questions on irradiance, PV cells, wiring, installation safety and troubleshooting, with a score at the end.

items.title: Solar Smart Technician – Advanced Challenge
items.desc: 30 harder questions: string sizing, standards, PID, protection devices, temperature loss and performance checks.

modules.note: Google Forms. Each opens in a new tab.
